mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_user_event_daily (event_date, event_type, page_path, content_type, content_id, event_count, unique_anon_count, unique_user_count) SELECT #{date}, event_type, page_path, '', '', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type IN ('PAGE_VIEW', 'OUTBOUND_CLICK', 'SEARCH') AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event_type, page_path ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = VALUES(event_count), unique_anon_count = VALUES(unique_anon_count), unique_user_count = VALUES(unique_user_count)

INSERT INTO site_user_event_daily (event_date, event_type, page_path, content_type, content_id, event_count, unique_anon_count, unique_user_count) SELECT #{date}, event_type, '', COALESCE(content_type, ''), COALESCE(content_id, ''), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'CONTENT_CLICK' AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event_type, COALESCE(content_type, ''), COALESCE(content_id, '') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = VALUES(event_count), unique_anon_count = VALUES(unique_anon_count), unique_user_count = VALUES(unique_user_count)

INSERT INTO site_user_event_daily_device (event_date, device_type, unique_anon_count, page_view_count) SELECT #{date}, device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id), SUM(is_new) FROM ( SELECT anon_id, COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown') AS device_type, CASE WHEN LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) IS NULL OR LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) < created_at - INTERVAL 30 SECOND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) t GROUP BY device_type ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unique_anon_count = VALUES(unique_anon_count), page_view_count = VALUES(page_view_count)

INSERT INTO site_user_event_daily_session (event_date, session_count, page_view_count, unique_anon_count) SELECT #{date}, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), SUM(is_new), COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) FROM ( SELECT anon_id, session_id, CASE WHEN LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) IS NULL OR LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) < created_at - INTERVAL 30 SECOND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) t ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_count = VALUES(session_count), page_view_count = VALUES(page_view_count), unique_anon_count = VALUES(unique_anon_count)

INSERT INTO site_user_event_daily_referrer (event_date, referrer_host, event_count) SELECT #{date}, referrer, COUNT(*) FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND referrer IS NOT NULL AND referrer <> '' AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY referrer ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = VALUES(event_count)
